data_fields.name: block_ratio_global
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.25 when global block switch on, else 0

data_fields.name: offense_factor_clamp_adjust
data_fields.donor_constant: factor (truncated), adjust, min, max per attack type

data_fields.name: guard_regen_per_tick
data_fields.donor_constant: guardrate per cadence; half while blocking

data_fields.name: block_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: model thold plus defense blockthreshold, attack force must reach it

best_idea: A blocked hit spends a guard meter and takes a block-ratio share of the damage, and an empty guard turns the next hit into a zero-damage guard break that refills the meter.
decision_why: The offense-then-defense order and the zero-damage guard break fit the duel step, but the guard meter is row 3, its regen and block eligibility must run on server ticks, and the lethal-chip re-entry must not be copied.
acceptance: A server test with a guard of 100 and guardCost 40 blocks hits 1 to 3 at round(force x 0.25) with no HP loss beyond that, and the 4th hit is unblocked, deals 0 damage and leaves the guard refilled to 100; a hit below the block threshold is never blocked.
